questions.stem: Which of the following is true regarding polycythemia vera?
questions.solutionHtml:
Leukocytosis
  • Polycythemia vera results in Panmyelosis (an increase in all myeloid components including leukocytes).


Dacie & Lewis Practical Haematology, 12th Edition, Page No. 97, Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 624, 625, 662

Lung carcinoma
  • Polycythemia is not caused by Lung Carcinoma.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 622
